description: This file implements the SugarOAuthServer class, which provides OAuth server functionalities such as token handling, consumer lookup, and request validation for the SuiteCRM platform. It manages OAuth tokens, verifies requests, and generates OAuth tokens and URLs.

classes.name: SugarOAuthServer
classes.description: Implements OAuth server functionalities for SuiteCRM, including token management, consumer validation, and request verification.

classes.name: OAuthException
classes.description: Custom exception class used when OAuth extension is not loaded.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Verifies if required PHP functions for hashing are available.

methods.name: enabled
methods.description: Checks if OAuth support is enabled based on available PHP functions.

methods.name: lookupConsumer
methods.description: Finds and validates a consumer by its key.

methods.name: timestampNonceChecker
methods.description: Verifies timestamp and nonce for request validity.

methods.name: decodePostGet
methods.description: Decodes and sanitizes POST and GET data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the OAuth provider, checks request validity, and sets up handlers.

methods.name: requestToken
methods.description: Generates a new OAuth request token.

methods.name: accessToken
methods.description: Generates an OAuth access token after validation.

methods.name: authUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for OAuth authorization.

methods.name: authorizedToken
methods.description: Retrieves the current authorized token if available.

methods.name: authorization
methods.description: Fetches authorization data from the current token.

methods.name: reportProblem
methods.description: Generates a string report for OAuth-related exceptions.
